messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate from ingress gateway (region-us-west). Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/stream. Severity: P1. Page sent to oncall rotation.

Irina (oncall): I'm on it. booting runbook now. first check: customer impact and whether fallback routing is active.

Sam K: seeing a spike in client 502/504s, ~18% error rate for last 6m. Affected customers: 3 high-traffic tenants (tenant-a, tenant-b, tenant-c). No recent deploys reported.

Maya R: confirmed. latency p95 for ingress jumped from 120ms -> 1.8s. token throughput down ~22%. charts: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/ingress

Irina (oncall): hypothesis 1: upstream model hosts are retrying and causing head-of-line blocking at the gateway. hypothesis 2: autoscaler lag + kube pod restarts amplifying retries. Asking for request logs with correlation ids.

Lee H: grabbing logs now. running: `rg "corr=" /var/log/ingress/* | head -n 200` — found many requests with `retries=3` and `upstream_status=504`. sample corr ids: corr=8f3b2a, corr=8f3b2b, corr=8f3b2c.

Devon Ops: sharing KV logs for corr=8f3b2a -> `2026-02-19T14:12:03Z corr=8f3b2a route=/v1/generate retries=3 upstream=runtime-ssd-07 status=504 latency=1492ms user=tenant-a`. Also see mixing of `client_retry=true` flags.

Irina (oncall): thanks. immediate mitigations: 1) enable route fallback to smaller model variant on ingress for /v1/generate, 2) temporarily increase gateway concurrency and throttle downstream retries, 3) disable client-side retry header passthrough. I'll run the commands.

Irina (oncall): (runbook cmds)
```
# enable fallback rule
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPS" https://controlplane.local/configs/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","fallback_model":"redwood-mini-v2","enabled":true}'
# throttle downstream retries at edge
kubectl -n infra patch configmap gateway-config --patch '{"data":{"max_retries":"1","max_inflight_per_route":"400"}}'
```

Sam K: after fallback toggle — seeing error rate drop to 6% in next 2m. p95 latency falling to 340ms. partial mitigation working. good call. :thumbsup:

Maya R: pushing timeline build into thread:
- 14:05 UTC: first pager, error rate rising
- 14:07 UTC: oncall paged, runbook started
- 14:09 UTC: logs show retries=3, upstream 504 from runtime pool
- 14:11 UTC: fallback rule enabled
- 14:13 UTC: error rate decreasing, some spikes remain

Lee H: digging into upstream hosts: runtime-ssd-07 shows increased GC and OOM kill at 14:04-14:06; kube events show node pressure and preemptions. suspects: noisy tenancy causing eviction cascade + client retry amplification.

Devon Ops: good hypothesis. also found `x-client-retries: 3` header in a batch of requests from tenant-b — their SDK recently bumped retry to 3. This amplifies the upstream failing window.

Irina (oncall): mitigation 2: reached out to tenant-b SE and asked them to temporarily set client retries=0 for 10m. also enabling a per-tenant rate cap on ingress for suspected tenants.

Sam K: can we export a log bundle for RCA? need full request traces for corr ids above and associated pod logs.

Lee H: generating bundle: `./tools/logbundle --corr 8f3b2a,8f3b2b,8f3b2c --since 20m -o /tmp/rca-2487654321.tar.gz` will upload to /artifacts/incidents/2487654321/ once finished.

Maya R: customer impact note for public channel: "Partial degradation for some tenants between 14:04-14:13 UTC, mitigated by fallback rules. Root cause under investigation: upstream host pressure and retry amplification." I'll draft.

Irina (oncall): next steps (RCA in-thread):
- collect full trace bundles and pod-level metrics (Lee)
- confirm tenant-sdk retry change (Sam)
- review autoscaler config & preemption settings (Devon)
- prepare follow-up fixes: enforce client retry passthrough block; add per-tenant ingress caps; autoscaler headroom adjustments

Devon Ops: putting a short-term autoscaler tweak: increase min replicas for runtime-pool-us-west by +2 to reduce cold-start pressure. rolling now.

Sam K: noting correlation ids for deeper trace: corr=8f3b2a (tenant-a), corr=8f3b2b (tenant-b), corr=8f3b2c (tenant-c). we'll attach these to the RCA doc.

Irina (oncall): status update: error rate stable ~4% for last 6m. keeping this thread live until full postmortem. if anyone sees re-escalation ping me.

incident-bot: Incident acknowledged; creating incident ticket INC-2026-34829 and assigning to eng-runtime for RCA.

Lee H: uploaded bundle: /artifacts/incidents/2487654321/rca-2487654321.tar.gz (contains ingress logs, pod logs, traces).

Maya R: public message posted in #incidents-updates. adding owners for follow-up: eng-runtime, eng-sre, client-sdk.

Devon Ops: adding postmortem checklist: reproduce locally with high retry header, run load test with tenant-b SDK settings, validate fallback correctness.

Sam K: thanks all. summary and next steps in doc: https://confluence.redwood/INC-2487654321-rca (draft).

Irina (oncall): handing off to oncall next shift: @Sam K will drive RCA writeup. I'll leave follow-up action items in the ticket. handing off at 15:00 UTC. :white_check_mark:

Sam K: taking handoff. marking thread resolved for pager; keeping thread open for RCA notes.

(thumbs up reactions and a few :coffee: messages)
